correctness.rationale: Exact signed-incidence reduction L=BMB^T is valid for all 0<a<=1, with rank-three retained columns. The pseudoinverse congruence gives the exact 3x3 SPD preconditioned matrix. Inherited weights give a rank-one update with exact eigenvalues; additive weights yield a cubic whose three simple positive roots converge at O(a); interlacing plus the sharp 2x2 correlation lower bound holds for all positive diagonal weights. The matching upper and lower bounds establish the limiting infimum and sharp gap. A standalone Python standard-library checker passes 74 rational and numerical checks; these are not substituted for the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The literature’s fixed-subcomplex weighting problem has a distinct spectral-conditioning objective with practical relevance when face subsampling is prescribed. On the natural reciprocally graded tetrahedral face weights, inherited face weights cause condition O(1/a) but a local additive rule obtains O(1), provably asymptotically optimal among all admissible positive face reweightings. The constant is an exact structural obstruction from invariant two-face correlation, a benchmark for reweighting fixed subcomplexes. The result neither repeats generic diagonal-scaling existence nor claims general or chosen-face performance.
